node_geometry.node_rule: AZO stations with exact names 148 FLO CRUZ through 157 FLO CRUZ inclusive
node_geometry.coordinate_rule: component-wise median deployment latitude and longitude per station

response_semantics.positive_label: at least one admissible retained yellow-eel detection at an eligible study receiver during the Monday-Sunday scored week
response_semantics.negative_label: eligible receiver-week with zero admissible retained yellow-eel detections; interpreted only as observed non-detection, never biological absence
response_semantics.datetime_parser: strip; replace terminal Z with +00:00; datetime.fromisoformat; any failure stops

temporal_split.receiver_week_effort: eligible when union deployment coverage contains at least 5 calendar days in that Monday-Sunday week

process_source.release_anchor_rule: nearest study receiver to each retained tag release coordinate; fixed before response
process_source.observed_only: first scored week uses release anchors; later weeks use only receivers detected in the immediately previous scored week
process_source.release_persistence: every scored week uses the union of fixed release anchors and immediately previous-week detected receivers
process_source.interpretation: source modes are possibility hypotheses, not claims of true movement history

world_scale.one_step_support: source receiver plus every study receiver within the world's Haversine threshold

layer_a_rules.prediction_update_order: for week t compute world support and Layer B from worlds surviving through t-1; only after the week-t observed labels are known update survival for t+1
layer_a_rules.positive_falsification: a surviving world is eliminated if any positive receiver in week t is unsupported by that world's pre-outcome week-t support
layer_a_rules.negative_falsification: none; observed non-detection never eliminates a world

layer_b_representation.support_value: binary one-step world support 0/1 for each receiver

comparators.augmented: same RandomForestClassifier on identical conventional_feature_names followed by the unchanged 10 Layer-B features

preprocessing_model_fit.fit_policy: fit exactly once per arm on all calibration receiver-weeks; no tuning; predict all heldout receiver-weeks once
preprocessing_model_fit.coordinate_center: mean of the ten frozen station coordinates; longitude converted with cos(mean latitude)*111.32 km/degree and latitude with 110.574 km/degree
preprocessing_model_fit.degree: number of other study receivers within each frozen geometry threshold
preprocessing_model_fit.release_anchor_tag_count: number of 36 retained tags assigned to the focal receiver's nearest release anchor
preprocessing_model_fit.nearest_release_anchor_distance_km: minimum Haversine distance to any fixed release-anchor station
preprocessing_model_fit.release_anchor_exposure_geo3: sum over 36 retained tags exp(-distance(focal, tag anchor)/0.49919805227165576)
preprocessing_model_fit.previous_week_detected: 0 in first scored week; otherwise previous receiver-week label
preprocessing_model_fit.weeks_since_last_detection: week_index+1 if never previously detected; otherwise current week_index minus most recent prior positive week_index
preprocessing_model_fit.cumulative_prior_detected_weeks: count of earlier positive weeks for focal receiver
preprocessing_model_fit.previous_week_detected_receiver_count: 0 in first scored week; otherwise count of positive study receivers in immediately previous week
preprocessing_model_fit.previous_week_source_count_geok: count of immediately previous-week positive receivers at distance <= threshold k from focal receiver, including focal receiver when previously positive; 0 in first week
preprocessing_model_fit.previous_week_source_exposure_geok: sum exp(-distance/threshold k) over immediately previous-week positive receivers; 0 in first week
preprocessing_model_fit.cumulative_prior_global_detected_receive: sum of all positive receiver-week labels strictly before the current week

metrics_decision.primary_macro: unweighted mean of the five full four-week block log losses
metrics_decision.supplementary: pooled heldout log loss may include all 23 heldout weeks, including the terminal three weeks, but cannot change the primary status

runtime_runner.response_access: exactly one full HTTP GET of raw_detection_data.csv after authorization marker
runtime_runner.response_identity_check: verify Zenodo metadata name/size/md5 before GET and compute MD5 while streaming the sole response GET; any mismatch stops
runtime_runner.streaming_rule: parse CSV once; do not persist or reopen raw response; aggregate only frozen receiver-week positives plus audit counters
execution_order: load and fingerprint response-independent deployment/eel metadata
single response stream and frozen parsing/exclusions
if count pass build sequential Layer A/Layer B and conventional lagged features
fit same frozen RF in two arms

non_estimable_stop.reason: no public aggregate evidence exactly matches frozen receiver-week event/non-event and block-both-class counts
terminal_zero_fit_conditions: all Layer-A worlds eliminated before feature completion
calibration response has fewer than two classes
